headline: CEO of Regional Bank Sells 168,000 Shares for $12.1 Million, According to Latest SEC Filing
summary: Van Saun also donated 38,350 shares to charity, reducing his direct holdings by 13% while maintaining an $80.50 million equity stake in the company.
